summary_1line: Draupadi wakes Bhima and laments their humiliations in exile, especially Kichaka’s harassment and Yudhishthira’s fall from king to disguised servant.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi, pale and distraught, shakes the sleeping Bhima in the night as he rises from a rich couch to hear her grief.
Draupadi stands anguished while Bhima, disguised as the cook Vallava, wrestles fierce beasts in the palace arena as royal women watch and laugh.
